thread:
maria_ops: starting war room for hosted inference 5xx/timeouts — multiple customers reporting 502/504 around 09:05 UTC. launching triage.
deploy-bot: incident created: INC-20260317-09:05 (automated)
kevin_support: customers affected: corpA, fintechB, one internal smoke test. corpA opened a ticket: high error rate and timeouts.
jonathan_sre: seeing gateway spike in queue depth + backend 502s from runtime pool. p95 latency for gateway jumped from 180ms -> 2.4s.
alice_engineer: attaching a quick repro curl from support ticket to try locally:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input": "<~85k char long prompt>"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
li_research: odd data point — a model-side tokenization change merged yesterday increased token counts for multi-line prompts by ~30%. might blow up request sizing heuristics.
emma_prod: we rolled a minor tokenizer tweak to improve whitespace handling at 02:00 UTC. @li_research is that the change?
li_research: yes, that was the one. local tests showed different token counts for some customer prompts. not flagged as breaking.
jonathan_sre: logs show many runtime workers rejecting requests due to kv-cache memory pressure and then backend proxies returning 502. also seeing a flood of auth retries: KMS returned 429 on token decrypt for some request paths.
maria_ops: can we confirm chain: larger token counts -> bigger kv cache footprints -> evictions -> runtime errors -> gateway 502s/timeouts?
alice_engineer: reproducing locally produced similar 502s when I scale prompt length. stack snippet: `runtime: kvcache OOM eviction -> handler panicked -> proxy 502`
kevin_support: customers reporting billing errors alongside 5xx in one case — billing checks are downstream of auth, could be correlated.
jonathan_sre: creating short-term mitigations: 1) rollback tokenizer change in canary, 2) throttle incoming long requests at gateway (reject > X tokens), 3) increase autoscaler headroom for runtime pool.
kevin_support: notify affected customers with a short note — we're investigating and have mitigation plan. I'll draft. :eyes:
maria_ops: action: @alice_engineer and @jonathan_sre to put rollback canary in next 10m and apply gate rule to drop large requests. @kevin_support to send customer comms. @li_research to prepare token-count diff report. @emma_prod to schedule postmortem.
alice_engineer: starting canary rollback now. will post deploy-bot output.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback/tokenizer-revert -> canary (nodes: canary-03, canary-04)
alice_engineer: canary rollback completed, health checks passed.
jonathan_sre: applying temporary gateway filter: drop requests with token_estimate > 5000 with 403 + structured reason. patch applied to edge config.
kevin_support: sent customer comms draft, added FAQ on retries and suggested temporary rate-limiting on their side.
li_research: uploading tokenization diff: increase in token count concentrated on long whitespace-heavy prompts and triple-quoted blocks. will add unit tests.
maria_ops: immediate metrics: gateway error rate down from 8% -> 1.2% after rollback + gate. p95 latency back to ~220ms. good containment.
emma_prod: scheduling postmortem doc and sync: proposed 2026-03-18 15:00 UTC. I'll add required attendees.
kevin_support: corr telephony note to corpA: we applied a fix and implemented request-size protection. Monitoring for next 24h.
alice_engineer: follow-ups (short): a) add pre-submit test to catch token-count regressions b) backfill unit tests for the tokenizer c) add autoscaler safety buffer to runtime pools.
jonathan_sre: follow-ups operational: a) implement circuit-breaker for kv-cache fullness b) add alert for auth KMS 429s linked to request sizes c) increase headroom by +15% for next 24h.
li_research: research follow-up: add a small corpus of real-world multi-line prompts to CI and compare token counts against golden baseline.
emma_prod: comms / product follow-ups: a) change default docs to warn about very long prompts b) add opt-in prompt-length enforcement for Dedicated customers c) update changelog process for tokenizer changes.
maria_ops: assigning owners: alice_engineer -> tokenizer tests + rollback PR audit; jonathan_sre -> circuit-breaker + autoscaler change; li_research -> token diff + CI harness; kevin_support -> customer comms + support playbook; emma_prod -> postmortem doc + meeting.
alice_engineer: estimate: tests + PR by EOD today.
jonathan_sre: will push autoscaler headroom now and file infra RFC for circuit-breaker.
kevin_support: opening a support runbook stub in the docs repo with repro steps and canned replies.
maria_ops: postmortem action list will be tracked in the incident doc. Root cause (draft): tokenizer regression increased token counts -> resource pressure on KV cache -> runtime failures -> gateway 502/504 cascade; contributing factor: KMS rate limit surfaced during auth retries.
li_research: note: tokenizer fix was well-intentioned but lacked regression baseline for token counts on edge cases. will add gating.
emma_prod: meeting invite sent. agenda: timeline, RCA, action items, customer comms.
kevin_support: corpA confirmed reduction in errors after our fix. they want a brief summary for their compliance team.
maria_ops: good job everyone. we'll keep monitoring. postmortem doc link will be added here when ready. :white_check_mark:
